notes: Source: board 'WERSJA JASNA' (primary) + 'WERSJA CIEMNA' + one-pager header. Silhouette fitted from sub-pixel contours of the light and dark instances (both arms, rotated 180 deg onto each other, jointly least-squares fitted). Each arm = 9 anchors: exact semicircular cap (R=154.91, 3.87u) + 2 straight edges + 6 cubics anchored at extrema/inflections. earth = heaven rotated 180 deg about (480,480), baked. Scale: bbox width fitted to 960 (24u); bbox height 923.93 (23.1u), ratio 1.039, so the mark is not 24u x 24u in the pixels. Layering is NOT rotation symmetric: in heaven the right lobe is a soft overlay (alpha ramp + faint crease); in earth the bottom lobe is a crisp overlay with a vertical left edge at x=293.5.
